rows.note: Für steuerbare Einkommen über Fr. 200 000.– beträgt die einfache Steuer für das ganze Einkommen acht Prozent.

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Appenzell; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Appenzell; other communes in Appenzell Innerrhoden set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)
